<script>
const heroStartDate = new Date("2026-04-01");
function updateHeroCountdown() {
  const today = new Date();
  const diff = heroStartDate - today;
  const days = Math.ceil(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  document.getElementById("heroCountdown").innerHTML =
    days > 0 ? `⏳ Only ${days} Days Left – Batch Starts 01 April 2026` : "🚀 Batch Started!";
}
updateHeroCountdown();
</script>

<div class="csv-icon">📋</div><strong>URS</strong><small>High Impact</small></div>

onclick="showCSV('Supplier / Vendor Assessment','Evaluates vendor capability, quality system and compliance.')">
<div class="csv-icon">🏭</div><strong>Vendor Assessment</strong><small>Medium Impact</small></div>

<div class="csv-step high" data-doc="Validation Plan"
onclick="showCSV('Validation Plan','Defines validation strategy, scope, responsibilities and deliverables.')">
<div class="csv-icon">🗂️</div><strong>Validation Plan</strong><small>High Impact</small></div>

<div class="csv-step medium" data-doc="Functional Specification"
onclick="showCSV('Functional Specification','Describes system functionality mapped to URS.')">
<div class="csv-icon">⚙️</div><strong>FS</strong><small>Medium Impact</small></div>

<div class="csv-step medium" data-doc="Design Specification"
onclick="showCSV('Design Specification','Explains technical design and architecture.')">
<div class="csv-icon">🧩</div><strong>DS</strong><small>Medium Impact</small></div>

<div class="csv-step high" data-doc="Functional Risk Assessment"
onclick="showCSV('Functional Risk Assessment','Assesses risks associated with system functions.')">
<div class="csv-icon">⚠️</div><strong>FRA</strong><small>High Impact</small></div>

<div class="csv-step medium" data-doc="Configuration Specification"
onclick="showCSV('Configuration Specification','Documents configured parameters of the system.')">
<div class="csv-icon">🔧</div><strong>CS</strong><small>Medium Impact</small></div>

<div class="csv-step high" data-doc="IQ Protocol"
onclick="showCSV('Installation Qualification','Verifies correct installation of hardware and software.')">
<div class="csv-icon">💻</div><strong>IQ</strong><small>High Impact</small></div>

<div class="csv-step high" data-doc="OQ Protocol"
onclick="showCSV('Operational Qualification','Verifies system functions operate as intended.')">
<div class="csv-icon">📈</div><strong>OQ</strong><small>High Impact</small></div>

<div class="csv-step high" data-doc="PQ Protocol"
onclick="showCSV('Performance Qualification','Confirms system performs consistently in real use.')">
<div class="csv-icon">🏁</div><strong>PQ</strong><small>High Impact</small></div>

<div class="csv-step high" data-doc="Traceability Matrix"
onclick="showCSV('Traceability Matrix','Ensures end-to-end traceability from URS to testing.')">
<div class="csv-icon">🔗</div><strong>TM</strong><small>High Impact</small></div>

<div class="csv-step high" data-doc="Validation Summary Report"

<div class="csv-icon">✅</div><strong>VSR / Release</strong><small>High Impact</small></div>

<script>
function showCSV(title,desc){
document.getElementById("csvDetails").innerHTML=
"<strong>"+title+"</strong><br><br>"+desc;
}

/* Auto Highlight Animation */
const steps=document.querySelectorAll(".csv-step");
let i=0;
setInterval(()=>{
steps.forEach(s=>s.classList.remove("active"));
steps[i].classList.add("active");
i=(i+1)%steps.length;
},2200);
</script>
